newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kansai Elec capital investment seen slowing--paper.
newsitem.headline: Kansai Elec capital investment seen slowing--paper.

text.p: Kansai Electric Power Co Inc will reduce its capital investment in the year to March 31, 1997 by eight percent from the previous year and it will maintain the 1996/97 level in 1997/98, a Japanese business daily said on Friday.

As a result, Kansai Electric's capital investment in 1996/97 and 1997/98 will be about 50 billion yen per year lower than levels projected in the company's original capital spending plans, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
Now Kansai Electric expects its 1996/97 capital investment to be about 689 billion yen, the paper said.

The cut is in response to complaints from users about high electricity rates, the paper said, adding that the Ministry of International Trade and Industry, which supervises Japan's electric power industry, has also called for lower electricity rates.
Kansai Electric was not immediately available for comment.
